title: Jesus... I Replayed This Morning's Meeting In My Head All Night. 😵‍💫
topic: he replays every meeting at night hunting for the sentence he got wrong, and calls it preparing for tomorrow

bible.text: Therefore do not worry about tomorrow, for tomorrow will worry about itself. Today has enough trouble of its own.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus... I've replayed this morning's meeting in my head all night. 😵‍💫

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Looking for the exact sentence I said wrong. It's 1am. The court in my head is still open.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Replaying isn't preparing. It's punishing, and the verdict never comes, so the trial never ends.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: But if I don't rehearse, I'll repeat it tomorrow.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Tomorrow deserves one run-through. Not twelve.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Put today down. You can pick it up lighter in the morning.

lines.speaker: engagement
lines.text: What do you replay at night? 👇
